text:
maria.devex: Heads up — platform rolled out the new 'narrowcast' routing policy to prod this morning. I'm seeing weird quota attribution in the console for a couple customers. Anyone else?

jon.eng-platform: Thx for flagging. We enabled narrowcast v1 at 08:32 UTC. It should be backward compatible. What exactly do you see?

maria.devex: Console shows some requests attributed to both 'legacy-route' and 'narrowcast' simultaneously, and token counts look doubled for batched calls. Screenshot coming.

kevin.eng-runtime: That smells like header canonicalization. Some clients might be sending both `x-route` and `X-Route`. We have a shim but it doesn't handle mixed cases when both are present.

priya.sdk: Which clients are affected? We shipped a Python patch last week that normalizes headers. TS hasn't shipped the same normalization yet.

sara.product: Customer on Dedicated reported ~2x token burn after 09:00; they use our TS client. Example from their logs: 
```
headers: {"x-route": "narrowcast.v1", "X-Route": "legacy"}
```

jon.eng-platform: Oof. Our routing lookup lowercases header names, but the shim that merges multiple hints is doing exact-name checks. So when both exist, we end up computing two route hashes.

priya.sdk: I can push a quick TS patch today to normalize keys. Do we want to deprecate the old header name outright or provide fallback for a while?

kevin.eng-runtime: Do not require immediate removal. Server-side hotfix: prefer normalized narrowcast header if present, ignore legacy if normalized exists. Also emit a telemetry tag `route.normalized=true|false` for a month.

maria.devex: For auditing, console should show both the raw incoming header and the normalized route for 30 days so CS can reconcile billing. Can sampling be used so we don't explode metrics?

jon.eng-platform: Yes — we'll add a sampled event stream: default 1% sampling for raw headers, customers can opt up in console. Drafting PR now.

priya.sdk: Python patch (PR ready) lowercases keys and respects `SDK_ROUTE_HEADER_FALLBACK` env var. TS patch will mirror this. I'll cut Py 0.23.4 and TS 1.8.2 after tests.

kevin.eng-runtime: Backend fix in flight: compute quota route-hash only from normalized value. Rolling out to canary hosts 2/6 now. If canary looks good we'll roll fast.

maria.devex: Also update the migration guide + release notes. We should clearly state: server behavior will prefer new narrowcast header; old header accepted for 30 days then deprecated.

sara.product: Please add this to the customer-facing migration checklist and notify CS + account owners for Dedicated customers.

priya.sdk: Quick integration note for Devs: in JS/Node, headers can come in different casings depending on HTTP lib. Suggested snippet for apps: 
```
// normalize headers
const headers = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(req.headers).map(([k,v]) => [k.toLowerCase(), v]));
if (headers['x-route-alt']) headers['x-route'] = headers['x-route-alt'];
```

jon.eng-platform: Can SDKs surface an opt-in sampling header so console can correlate sample ids? Something like `X-Console-Sample: 1/100`. Security/PII considerations first, though.

maria.devex: Good idea but let's gate it: sampling id only for internal telemetry and only if customer enables. Update privacy blurb.

deploy-bot: canary deploy completed on host-2 at 09:12 UTC :white_check_mark:

kevin.eng-runtime: I'll run the routing regression suite against the TS patch once it's up. If anything fails we'll revert the hotfix and iterate.

priya.sdk: TS CI flakes on one test locally (header-casing unit). Will ping @kevin for a quick runtime run after I push.

maria.devex: Timeline proposal: hotfix live now, SDK patches today, telemetry console tile + opt-in next week, deprecation notice 30 days from today. I'll draft the customer announcement thread and internal runbook.

sara.product: Adding to release tracker and pinging CS to prepare messaging.

maria.devex: Thanks all — I'll post the announcement once PRs land. Will also open an incident ticket if we cross our customer-impact threshold.
